description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima's Student.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Sakashima's Student and another permanent you control.
Activate Sakashima's Student by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sakashima's Student
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
